text.aria-label: Subtitle text '6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 forecast runs on Tuesdays, July 2025 to June 2026; pooled mixture of 51 ENS members, 3 seeds. Dot: estimate. Line: 99.58% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds (a 5% level corrected for 12 planned contrasts). Orange: the headline contrast. Black dashed line: no change. Green dotted line: the -0.05 threshold for a gain.'
